Lina (Horizon): Morning — launching a regional demo for EU/APAC tomorrow 09:30 CET. Need temporary allowlist + qps bump on eu-west-1 and ap-northeast-1, with us-west-2 as warm fallback. CIDRs: 198.51.100.128/25 and 203.0.113.0/25. Request qps=1000 for 10h and auto-revoke at window end. Please log token spend; renewal in ~4 weeks so well want usage for commercial.
Ethan (CS): Got it. Can you confirm UTC start and steady vs peak? I'll add renewal note if spikes look risky.
Lina (Horizon): Start 08:30 UTC. Steady ~450 qps, peaks to 1000 for 6-8m every 20m. Yes please collect spend and perf snapshots at 30m and 2h.
Omar (Network Ops): Need CIDR ownership proof and confirmation of header auth or mTLS. Proposed auto_revoke timestamp OK?
Priya (Solutions): Draft config — confirm then I'll push canary 20m before start:
`customer:horizon,cidrs:[198.51.100.128/25,203.0.113.0/25],regions:[eu-west-1,ap-northeast-1,us-west-2],qps:1000,duration:10h,auto_revoke:2024-10-05T18:30:00Z`
Ethan (CS): Marking renewal status = "watching". Will schedule post-demo debrief and share enablement checklist + warmup tips.
Lina (Horizon): Confirm header auth with `x-horizon-key`. Also please advise on reserved capacity options for renewal.
quota-bot: Quota request created: +10k tokens/hr for horizon during window. Approve with `/approve quota 2755550001`
Ethan (CS): Approved. :white_check_mark:
Omar (Network Ops): Applying to staging. Smoke: `curl -I https://proxy.eu.redwood/health` -> `HTTP/1.1 200 OK`. Prod cutover 20m before start, monitoring p50 & 5xx. Fallback triggers at 80% util.
Priya (Solutions): Canary healthy at 08:13 UTC, prod pushed 08:20 UTC. No errors in first 15m. Posting perf snapshots at 30m and 2h. Auto-revoke scheduled.
Ethan (CS): I'll collect post-demo notes and capture renewal talking points. Lina — we'll send the spend + perf after 2h.
Lina (Horizon): Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Good luck! :rocket:
